entry.title: About
entry.content:
About

tramaj is written by Lucas DiCioccio, who also writes about it, and about the other tools it grows alongside, on his blog at dicioccio.fr. The source is on GitHub.

Related sites

  • Kitchen Sink — the static-site generator this site is made with. Its templating sections are evaluated by tramaj-hs, the Haskell implementation of tramaj.
  • dicioccio.fr — the author’s blog, also built with Kitchen Sink.
entry.summary: Who writes tramaj, where to read more from the author, and the site generator this site is built with.
